stem: After heavy rain during flowering, low field areas remain saturated and humidity stays high. What is the strongest response?
choices: Inspect drainage and crop condition, adjust irrigation to actual root-zone moisture, increase disease scouting, and include safe work conditions in the response plan
Resume the normal irrigation schedule immediately
Apply fertilizer to dry the root zone
Assume rain affects only the soil and not disease risk
rationale: Heavy rain can affect root oxygen, irrigation need and disease pressure simultaneously; response should be based on measured field conditions and safe work planning.
